_doc: The help resources panel shown when a player may be in real distress. Edit freely (e.g. add verified local helplines for your players' countries). Last checked Oct 2026: 112 is Nigeria's official toll-free emergency number; findahelpline.com lists free youth lines for Nigeria.
title: You're not alone
intro: This is a game, but you are real, and how you feel matters. If something is hurting you, please don't keep it to yourself.
steps: Talk to a trusted adult today: a parent, an aunt or uncle, a teacher, your school counsellor, a religious leader or a family friend.
If you are in danger right now, or someone is hurting you, call your local emergency number. In Nigeria that's 112.
If it's hard to say out loud, you can write it down and show it to someone you trust.

links.label: Free, confidential helplines for young people in Nigeria (e.g. Mentally Aware Nigeria Initiative, HDI Child Helpline)

footer: You can come back to the game whenever you're ready. Take care of yourself first. 💛
